featured_reviews.name: Aaliyah Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Frisbee in Bandra, and here’s the honest take… it’s small, crowded, slightly chaotic… but the food makes it worth it.
We began with their super spicy chicken strips, and when I say spicy, I mean fire-level heat. Crispy on the outside, juicy inside, and unapologetically bold, definitely not for the faint-hearted.
Next came the mini sliders, which I absolutely loved. The chicken was tender, flavorful, and perfectly balanced within those soft buns. Bite-sized, but packed with taste.
The real highlight, though, was the Nashville chicken burger. I’ve tried Nashville style chicken at many places, but this one was on a completely different level. The spice, the crunch, the juiciness, everything just worked. Easily one of the best I’ve had. And their fries deserve credit too, golden, crisp, and addictive.
The drinks were fairly average, your standard mojitos and regular options. Nothing bad, just nothing extraordinary.

The only downside? Space. It’s a very small outlet, and you often end up waiting outside for an hour or more. Inside, it can feel quite congested. But once you get your food, the wait starts making sense.

featured_reviews.name: Adriel Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
A burger joint that actually lives up to the hype!

Good Flippin' Burgers is easily one of my top picks when it comes to a no-nonsense, satisfying burger experience. The patties are juicy, flavourful, and clearly made with care — no dry, overcooked nonsense here. The buns are soft yet hold everything together perfectly (no collapsing halfway through your meal!), and the balance of sauces, cheese, and toppings hits the sweet spot.

The fries are golden, crisp, and addictive, especially the Peri Peri ones; and if you’re into sides, their chicken tenders and absolutely superb. For me, it's the sides that actually steal the show.

What I also love is the consistency. Whether you're dining in or ordering in, the quality doesn't drop. Service is usually quick, and the vibe is casual, clean, and efficient, exactly what you want from a great burger spot.

Highly recommend the “The Clucknator” or the “The Koren Krossover Ckikin burger 456”.

Tried both their Flippinade flavours, Cranberry and Lemon. The cranberry was surprisingly refreshing and gets a solid 4/5 from me. The lemon was okay, not bad, but didn’t quite hit the same mark 3/5.

These folks don’t just flip burgers, they nail the.

The sides, like Peri Fries and Atomic Tenders, are solid too. The ambiance is casual, with quick service that keeps things moving. It’s not a place for a gourmet experience, and I don’t think they’re claiming to be. It delivers exactly what you’d expect, reliably.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Butter Chicken Factory in Bandra is a haven for butter chicken enthusiasts. The restaurant's rendition of this classic dish is a delightful symphony of flavors – the chicken is perfectly marinated, the creamy tomato-based gravy strikes a harmonious balance of spice and sweetness. Each bite is a journey for the senses, a true culinary delight.

Sujeet's service adds a personal touch to the dining experience, ensuring a memorable visit. The mocktails, especially Pudeena Pani and Masala Shikanje, provide a refreshing start to the meal.

The Kabab Platter showcases a variety of both vegetarian and non-vegetarian delights. From the succulent Paneer Tikka to the flavorful Chicken Seekh Kebab, the assortment caters to diverse preferences.

Moving on to the mains, the Butter Chicken steals the show with its rich and decadent texture. Complemented by Butter Paneer and Dal Makhani, the restaurant offers a fulfilling array of choices.

The Bread Basket, featuring Chilli Garlic Laccha Paratha, Tandoori Roti, Pudina Paratha, and Churchur Naan, provides the perfect accompaniment to soak up the flavorful gravies. Rice lovers are not forgotten, as the restaurant offers a satisfying selection.

The meal concludes on a sweet note with Gulab Jamun, leaving diners with a lingering sweetness that perfectly caps off the gastronomic journey. Butter Chicken Factory in Bandra is undeniably a go-to spot for those seeking an authentic and indulgent butter chicken experience in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Rohan Bidi
featured_reviews.review_text: It's quite small, only a few tables, so coming in a large group isn't a good idea. For starters we ordered Dahi Ke Kebab and Kaali Mirch Chicken Tikka. The kebabs were okay, didn't quite have a specific flavour, though their taste was enhanced a lot by the accompanying chutney and spiced onions. The tikka was quite tender, would've liked the kaali mirch flavour to be a little stronger, but wasn't a bad dish at all. Along with the starters we had Lemon Iced Tea, and I liked it a lot, being served chilled and not diluted. And now we come to the business end of the meal, for this is what makes this place so good, the main course. Our order was Butter Chicken, Soya Tikka Masala, Chur Naan, Garlic Naan and Hari Mirch Lachha Paratha. And boy was all of it good!! I particularly liked the soya tikka and the paratha, and the Chur Naan was interesting too. The Garlic Naan complimented the soya tikka perfectly, and we ended up having a very satisfying lunch, more than happy to have visited this place. To sum it up, I highly recommend Butter Chicken Factory, tiny but comfy, very tasty main course, polite staff, worth visiting more than just once.

⭐ Jimi’s Burger, Bandra
Visited Jimi’s Burger, Bandra with a group of 4. Each of us ordered one burger, plus one combo with a drink and one starter. Overall, the experience was really good and worth the visit.

🍔 Burgers:

#Chicken Supreme Burger – 4.5/5
The taste was amazing! Very flavourful, loaded with cheese, and the fried chicken was perfectly cooked. Definitely a must-try.

#Daebak Fried Chicken Burger – 3.5/5
Good, spicy, and Korean-style, but slightly too oily for my taste. The Korean sauces were a bit overpowering, which dulled the overall flavour. Still decent if you like bold, saucy burgers.

#Chicken Smash Hit Burger – 5/5
Absolutely loved this one! Small, juicy, and super tasty. This was my first chicken smash burger, and it was cooked perfectly with great flavour.

#Veg Jaw Breaker (Double Patty) – 4.5/5
The name says it all! Huge burger and definitely difficult to eat in one bite 😄
It’s the costliest veg option but worth it stuffed with paneer, patties, and veggies. Very filling and tasty.

🧀 Starters:

Mozzarella Cheese Sticks – 4.5/5
Crispy on the outside, gooey on the inside. Pure cheese taste and fried really well.

🍟 Sides & Drinks:

Peri Peri Fries & Mojito – 4.5/5
Both were really good and complemented the burgers nicely.

⏰ Crowd & Location:

We went on a Saturday evening, so it was quite crowded. Had to wait around 20 minutes for seating.

Reaching Bandra itself can take time on weekends. Parking info isn’t clear we came by auto.

📍 Other Outlets:
They also have outlets in Thane, Vashi, Malad, and Andheri.

Overall: Great food, especially the chicken burgers. Slight wait time on weekends, but totally worth it for burger lovers 🍔🔥

SAZ in BKC is one of those places that instantly wraps you in its warm, modern brasserie vibe the moment you walk in. With its chic interiors, dim-gold lighting and a playlist that feels curated for good moods, it’s the perfect blend of classy and comfortable — the kind of place you can go for a cosy brunch, a fun dinner date, or post-work cocktails that turn into long conversations.

The menu leans into American comfort with a gourmet twist, and almost everything that lands on the table has the “I want to take a picture first” aesthetic. Think bold flavours, generous portions, and dishes that balance indulgence with finesse.

From small plates to mains, every dish has its own personality — nothing bland, nothing boring. Their ingredients taste fresh, execution is neat, and the flavours hit that satisfying spot without being overly heavy.

The cocktails deserve their own chapter. SAZ is known for its bar game, and it shows — well-balanced drinks, interesting mixes, and something for every palate. Whether you like punchy, fruity, smoky or spirit-forward, you won’t feel short of options.

Service is smooth, attentive and friendly without being in-your-face. The staff actually knows the menu and recommends things based on what you like, not just what’s trending.

Overall, SAZ BKC is the perfect spot when you want a guaranteed good time — amazing food, great drinks, a stylish ambience and a vibe that feels both lively and relaxed. It’s the kind of place you walk out of thinking, “Yep, we’re coming back.”

Donna Deli has a few solid staples that keep pulling me back — the Rigatoni Ala Vodka and the Chili Dimsums are absolute classics and definite go-tos. The pasta is a bit creamier than I personally prefer, but a touch of chili oil usually brings it right where I want it.

featured_reviews.name: Naresh Shirodkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We’ve been regular visitors to Donna Deli and have always appreciated the good food and prompt service earlier. That consistency is what made us keep coming back.

However, over our last two visits, the experience has not been the same. The food quality didn’t match what we were used to, and the service took much longer than expected, with a wait time of over 30 minutes. There also appeared to be some lack of coordination between the order-taking and the kitchen, which led to part of our order being missed.

The staff were courteous and seemed to be doing their best, so this is not a complaint about their attitude or effort. It felt more like operational gaps that need attention.

It’s disappointing to see a place we genuinely like going through this phase, and we truly hope the management addresses these concerns and restores Donna Deli to its earlier standard.
